pieces.title: Raphael-circle talking head

takes.label: Talking head, raw Seedance output (480p)
takes.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A living oil-painted Renaissance portrait. A young man in a black beret and a red pleated overgarment stands behind a carpet-covered ledge, between two dark red-veined marble columns, in front of a flat grey wall. He speaks two short lines directly to the viewer, leans in a little between them, and ends holding his stare.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<image_1>>>: young man in his mid-20s, long pale face, long straight nose, heavy-lidded hazel-brown eyes, small closed knowing smile, shoulder-length straight auburn-red hair, soft black wool beret tilted slightly to frame right. Red pleated overgarment gathered at a thin white collar, worn over a black doublet with full black sleeves and a red embroidered cuff on the left wrist. His right hand (frame left) loosely holds a folded white letter; his left hand rests flat on the carpet, a thin gold ring on the ring finger. Red-and-black patterned carpet over the ledge. Dark marble columns with gilded bases at both edges. Rendered as smooth Renaissance oil paint with fine glazes and soft modelling on every surface, including his skin. Voice: warm, soft, young male tenor with a light Italian accent, unhurried and a little amused. 100% matches the reference.

FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING
Exactly <<<image_1>>>: half-length figure, body angled slightly toward frame left, head nearly frontal, face in the upper third of the frame, gaze straight into camera.

FORMAT MODE
One continuous shot, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
Medium shot at 29° portrait compression for the whole shot, no drift.

CAMERA
Locked off at eye level, face in sharp focus throughout. All movement comes from him.

ACTION
0.0s to 1.5s — he holds still, takes one slow breath, blinks once slowly; his fingers shift slightly on the letter.
1.5s to 4.5s — he speaks, calm and dry, at an unhurried pace, with a small pause between the two sentences: "Plato points up. Aristotle points down."
4.5s to 6.5s — silence. He leans slowly toward the lens by about 3 cm, chin dipping slightly; his eyes stay locked on the lens; the hand on the carpet stays flat.
6.5s to 8.5s — he speaks, quieter, almost a dare: "Tomorrow, you pick a side."
8.5s to 10.0s — he holds the stare into the lens, lips closed, perfectly still; the corners of his small smile deepen very slightly.

PERFORMANCE
Restraint and quiet confidence. Clear, accurate lip-sync with small, natural jaw movement, every word visibly shaped by the lips. Brow relaxed and level. Wet catch-light in both eyes. Breathing visible in the chest and shoulders. Hair moves only with his head. He moves like living paint: the glazes and soft modelling on his face, beret and red garment travel with every movement and keep their texture.

LIGHTING
Soft, even daylight from frame left at 5000K. Warm light on the left side of his face, gentle shadow along his right cheek and under the beret; as he leans in, the beret shadow deepens slightly across his brow. Flat, even light on the grey wall. Exposure constant for the whole shot.

AUDIO
His voice only, close-miked and dry, over a quiet stone-room tone. The second line is slightly softer and closer than the first.

STYLE
A Renaissance portrait come to life: smooth oil glazes, fine craquelure, matte panel surface, the muted palette of grey wall, deep red, black, auburn and gold. Every frame reads as oil on wood panel.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Beret, hair, red garment, black sleeves, embroidered cuff, letter, gold ring, carpet, columns and wall stay identical throughout. He keeps his pose and position; the lean is small and slow. The letter stays in his right hand and the left hand stays flat on the carpet. His gaze stays on the lens from 1.5s to the end. Oil-paint texture on every frame, start to finish.

pieces.title: Step-inside loop (20 s)

takes.label: step-inside loop take A, 480p draft
takes.prompt:
Create a 20-second vertical 9:16 cinematic loop using <<<image_1>>> as the exact opening frame: Raphael's School of Athens — a vast sunlit marble hall of coffered vaults and receding arches, with Plato and Aristotle at the top of a broad flight of steps among ancient philosophers.

The painting comes alive: the philosophers move naturally while the camera flies through the hall as if it were a real three-dimensional space, in one continuous take along a single winding path; the camera does not cut on its own. It turns to look where it is travelling, so the hall is seen from new angles. Things grow larger only because the camera physically moves closer, with real parallax. Close details flow naturally into wider views.

0s to 2s: The exact opening frame. The camera glides forward and down toward Heraclitus's white marble block in the left foreground.
2s to 4.5s: It reaches the small black inkwell on top of the block and curls around it, close, as Heraclitus, dark-haired and bearded in a plum-pink shirt, dips his pen.
4.5s to 7s: The camera skims left along the top of the block at hand height, passing in front of Heraclitus — his writing hand, the sheet of paper, his bowed bearded face just above the frame.
7s to 9.5s: It swings around beside the man in the orange robe and blue shawl at the left edge, close past the book he is writing in on his raised knee.
9.5s to 12.5s: The camera turns and climbs diagonally over the crowd on the left of the landing, heads and coloured robes passing below, toward the centre.
12.5s to 15s: It arrives very close to Plato's raised right index finger, his white beard and rose-red robe just beside it, Aristotle in blue beyond. Plato holds still, calm, his eyes on Aristotle.
15s to 17.5s: The camera tilts up and rises straight up where the finger points, past the coffered barrel vault and up through the round drum with its tall windows, into a hemispherical coffered dome like the Pantheon's, rings of square coffers sliding past, toward a perfectly circular open oculus at the very top of the dome, a bright disc of blue sky ringed by a smooth stone rim, a shaft of sunlight falling down through it. Below, everyone settles back into the exact poses of the painting.
17.5s to 20s: It rises up through the circular oculus into open blue sky; a sunlit white cloud drifts across the lens and fills the frame with soft white light, which clears into the exact opening composition of <<<image_1>>>, every figure in their original pose.

Warm, soft daylight through the arches, honey-white marble, deep blue sky, rich reds, blues and ochres in the robes. Fine dust and motes in the sunlight at several depths drift past the lens at different speeds. Shallow depth of field on close details, with soft bokeh behind. Smooth, unhurried, floating motion with gentle speed changes, never stopping. Calm expressions; hands move naturally with five fingers each. Rich, crisp texture in every robe, marble surface and face, matching the painting's colours and the identity of every figure.

<the airy echo of a great stone hall> <the scratch of a pen> <a soft rush of wind in the open sky> (a faint, slow string drone). No voices.
